description: Multi-pass AOV configuration for cinematic composite — all passes needed for professional-grade comp in Nuke/Flame. 16-bit/32-bit EXR only.

orchestration_stages.label: Beauty (RGBA) Pass
orchestration_stages.description: Full combined beauty pass — the final composite-ready image.

orchestration_stages.label: Diffuse and Indirect
orchestration_stages.description: Separate direct diffuse, indirect diffuse for relighting flexibility.
orchestration_hints: Separation enables relighting in comp without re-render.

orchestration_stages.label: Specular Pass
orchestration_stages.description: Specular highlight contribution for comp control.

orchestration_stages.label: Emission Pass
orchestration_stages.description: Emissive surface and volume emission — required for all volumetric FX.
artistic_constraints: emission AOV REQUIRED for all scenes with pyro/fire/smoke.
Enables fire intensity control in comp.

orchestration_stages.label: Volume Scatter and Transmission
orchestration_stages.description: Volume-specific AOVs for compositing flexibility on volumetric elements.

orchestration_stages.label: Depth Pass (World Units)
orchestration_stages.description: Z-depth in world-space units for depth-of-field and Z-composite.
orchestration_hints: Z (float) — distance from camera to surface in world units (meters).
artistic_constraints: MUST be in world units — not normalized 0–1.
Used for depth-of-field in comp and Z-composite keying.

orchestration_stages.label: Normal Pass
orchestration_stages.description: World-space surface normals for relighting and material override in comp.
orchestration_hints: N (RGB) — world space normal. Range -1 to 1 remapped to 0–1 in EXR.

orchestration_stages.label: Motion Vector Pass
orchestration_stages.description: World-space motion vectors for post-motion-blur compositing.
orchestration_hints: motionvector (RGB) — motion in screen space pixels.
Enable vector motion blur in comp using this pass.
Eliminates need for re-render if motion blur needs adjustment.

orchestration_stages.label: Cryptomatte
orchestration_stages.description: Per-element matte for clean isolation in comp without rotoscoping.
orchestration_hints: cryptomatte_asset — per-asset group matte (if shot has asset hierarchy).
artistic_constraints: REQUIRED — cryptomatte enables per-element color grading.
Set up before any render — cannot be added in post.

review_expectations.emission: Emission AOV active — visible in render output.
review_expectations.volume: Volume scattering and opacity passes present.
review_expectations.depth: Z pass in world units. 32-bit float.
review_expectations.motion: Motion vector pass present and world-space.
